design_reviews.scope: Olm one-to-one ratchet implementation and selected ratchet tests. Excludes Megolm, identity/prekey establishment, pickling, libolm migration, getters and optional low-level key export.

behavior_comparisons.scope: Equivalent bounded-work/retention risks; numeric limits and eviction policies differ.

design_reviews.design_decision: Keep bounded candidate derivation followed by authenticated commit and single-use delayed keys. Its separate derivation and retention limits are policy tradeoffs, not a reason to change this profile. Check effective dependency erasure features as well as wrapper types.
design_reviews.upstream_execution: Source and test review; this upstream suite was not executed.

design_reviews.scope: Four ordinary sender-ratchet tests and their implementation. MLS group trees, membership/epoch transactions and draft virtual-client DualUseRatchet are different protocols and are excluded.
design_reviews.design_decision: Retain explicit generation-overflow rejection, bounded forward derivation and deletion after use. Group key-tree and own-message recovery semantics do not belong in a two-endpoint session.
design_reviews.upstream_execution: Source and test review; this upstream suite was not executed.

design_reviews.scope: One-to-one double-ratchet suite plus hybrid KEM rotation tests. Multi-device fanout, SQLite persistence, prekeys and alternate payload/encryption policies are excluded.

behavior_comparisons.scope: Includes combined gaps across the old and new DH chain, not only a single-chain limit.

design_reviews.design_decision: Keep tests for a global skipped-key bound across DH turns. Its message/time-based KEM cadence saves bandwidth but changes recovery timing; this profile requires a full KEM exchange at every alternating turn.
design_reviews.upstream_execution: Source and test review; this upstream suite was not executed.
